title: Mental Model
task: Run bin/sync.sh with Bash. Save its normal output in sync.out and save just its exit status as a single number in sync.status. Its diagnostic should still appear on your terminal.
hints: Run bash bin/sync.sh once and observe that it prints two lines.
Redirect only stdout with > sync.out. The diagnostic belongs on stderr.
Capture the status immediately with printf '%s\n' "$?" > sync.status.

checks.label: Only stdout is in sync.out
checks.feedback: Capture stdout with > and leave stderr attached to the terminal.

checks.label: The command's exit status was captured
checks.feedback: Read $? directly after the script or save it in a variable before another command.
